value.rationale: The exact all-budget classification isolates an objective-dependent, discontinuous restoration decision; a two-route reliability measure advocates diversification only beyond a sharp investment while max-single-path proxy always advocates concentration. Empirical relevance and broader graph variants remain unproved.
